Gym Trainer Shot Dead in South Delhi; Previous Murders Alleged

A gym trainer, Vijay Kumar, was shot dead in broad daylight on Monday morning in the Aya Nagar area of South Delhi. Multiple bullets were fired at him. One report alleged that this was the third murder involving the victim, with Vijay being called out before being shot 20 times. The incident occurred in the Aya Nagar area.
